known.via: English Wikipedia "South West France wine" (redirects to "South West France (wine region)")

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A wine region inland and south of Bordeaux, with about 39,500 acres in separate wine islands along the Dordogne and Garonne rivers and their tributaries. It holds Jurançon, Madiran, Bergerac and Gaillac. In Gers and Lot-et-Garonne, Colombard is the most planted grape.
